curated-fs-zina-lora: Sharp fat downstrokes with threadlike upstrokes make Zina feel striking, and it could front a bookshop logo without effort. Lora's gentle curves carry the paragraphs, though not endless ones.
curated-fugaz-one-gf-david-libre: Bent-wire energy, tight and zippy. Fugaz One has no thick-thin shifts at all, while David Libre's open terminals settle beneath it with a dignified, text serif calm.
curated-gf-aboreto-gf-imbue: Aboreto stands wide and commanding, its stems thick with hairline crossbars. Imbue underneath is snug and moderate in contrast, with a very large lowercase that makes paragraphs feel dense and dignified.
curated-gf-acme-fs-erode: Wire-bent and upright, Acme holds one constant line width across tall strokes and short rounded bodies. Erode's serif then adds a tall middle band and gentle weight shifts, softening the page with an editorial hush.
curated-gf-agu-display-gf-science-gothic: Distinctive, loopy and bold: Agu Display bends its strokes like thin plastic tubing. Science Gothic keeps every letter uniform in weight and its stroke ends far apart, so give that sans a little extra size.
curated-gf-aguafina-script-gf-red-hat-mo: Compact, tightly strung letters with a razor-scratch serif define Aguafina Script's closed, personal hand. Red Hat Mono ticks along in fixed-width, ballpoint-thin monospace, open and measured, a steady beat for a few lines.
curated-gf-akaya-kanadaka-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width with breathing counters, set against Akaya Kanadaka's pulled-back terminals and close-knit spacing. One sits plain, the other expressive.
curated-gf-akaya-telivigala-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans Linear A gaps its c visibly at any size, a clean foil for a poster print shop merch headline in Akaya Telivigala. And that heading crowds its glyphs like beads on a wire.
curated-gf-akronim-gf-bhutuka-expanded-o: Akronim snags its curves and clamps seams tight, closed and bold. BhuTuka Expanded One, a serif, slows the pace to a stroll with curvy, open letters, so the heading shouts while the body talks.
curated-gf-akronim-gf-inconsolata: Inconsolata brings structure, fixed-width and open-ringed. Against Akronim's closed, seam-tight, unmodulated letters, its monospace regularity makes the pair's sharpest quality a clash between loose precision and clamped drama.
